title.narrative: Artemida: Combating violence against women, Moldova 2024-2028
Artemida: Kampen mot våld mot kvinnor, Moldavien 2024-2028

description.narrative:
The project aims to provide an integrated response to the phenomenon of violence against women and domestic violence, strengthening both organizational capacities and essential partnerships to ensure sustainable and effective support to victims and communities.
The project aligns with the organizational strategy of NGO Artemida and aims to combat violence against women and domestic violence through a complex set of measures: 1. Strategic Analysis and Review: The annual update of the organizational strategy and those of fundraising and communication for better efficiency and long-term support. 2. Strengthening Organizational and Institutional Capacity: Creation of a modernized information system to facilitate case management and curriculum development for multidisciplinary teams. 3. Awareness Campaigns: Collaboration with the National Coalition "Life without violence" and the mass media to educate the public, change mentalities and reduce tolerance towards violence. 4. Research and Evaluation of Offender Programs: Analyzing the effectiveness of rehabilitation programs to reduce recidivism and improve victim safety. 5. Developing Partnerships and Sub-granting: Expanding collaboration with organizations that can bring complementary expertise and resources to achieving the objectives.

"Artemida: Bekämpning av våld mot kvinnor i norra regionen, Moldavien 2024-2028" syftar till att tillhandahålla ett integrerat och robust svar på fenomenet våld mot kvinnor och våld i hemmet, stärka både organisatorisk kapacitet och väsentliga partnerskap för att säkerställa hållbart och effektivt stöd till offren och samhällen.

`Artemida: Combating violence against women in Northern region, Moldova 2024-2028` aims to provide an integrated and robust response to the phenomenon of violence against women and domestic violence, strengthening both organizational capacities and essential partnerships to ensure sustainable and effective support to victims and communities.
